Step-by-step guide
Specifications
Vickers indenter (Ø3 mm, ASTM & ISO accredited certificate)
Load range: 0.098–306.4 N (10 gf–31.25 kgf)
Objective lenses: 5×, 10×, 20×, 50×
Test height: 0–148 mm
Motorised XY-stage: 357×208 mm, stroke 220×120 mm
Motorised Z-axis and 6-position measurement turret
Integrated PC with 15" touchscreen
High-resolution camera with automatic illumination, focus, and image evaluation
Software for fully automatic case depth evaluation
Test pattern editor included as standard
Optional accessories/capabilties
 100× objective lens
 Knoop and Brinell indenters (Max. 2 indenters; indenter shaft size Ø3 mm)
Overview camera for full part imaging
